name: XAU Hurst Exponent Adaptive Reversion
concept: Uses rolling Hurst exponent to dynamically switch between mean-reversion and trend-following modes based on market regime.
instructions: Calculate rolling Hurst exponent using log returns over a 50-bar window. If Hurst < 0.45, enter mean-reversion mode: buy when Z-score < -1.5 and sell when Z-score > 1.5. If Hurst > 0.55, enter trend mode: buy when price > EMA20 and sell when price < EMA20. Use ATR-based stops with 1.5x multiplier. Gate signals to London/NY sessions only.

name: XAU Variance Ratio Breakout
concept: Detects volatility regime shifts using variance ratio to identify explosive breakouts from consolidation.
instructions: Calculate variance ratio as ratio of 20-bar variance to 5-bar variance. When variance ratio > 2.5 and price breaks 20-bar high/low, enter trend direction. Use Donchian channels for breakout confirmation. Set stops at 2x ATR and targets at 3R. Only trade during high-liquidity sessions.

name: XAU Kalman Filter Price Deviation
concept: Uses Kalman filter to estimate true price and trades deviations from the filtered estimate.
instructions: Implement simplified Kalman filter with state = price, observation = close. Calculate deviation as (close - kalman_state) / kalman_std. Buy when deviation < -2.0 and sell when deviation > 2.0. Use 1.5x ATR stops and 2R targets. Filter with ADX < 20 to ensure ranging conditions.

name: XAU Standard Deviation Band Squeeze
concept: Identifies volatility compression using standard deviation bands and trades the expansion.
instructions: Calculate 20-bar standard deviation of returns. When std dev drops below 0.5x its 100-bar average, mark as squeeze. On squeeze release (std dev > 1.5x average), enter in direction of price movement. Use 2x ATR stops and 2.5R targets. Gate to London/NY killzones.

name: XAU Linear Regression Curve Deviation
concept: Trades deviations from a rolling linear regression curve to capture mean-reversion opportunities.
instructions: Fit 30-bar linear regression to close prices. Calculate residual as (close - regression_line) / regression_std. Buy when residual < -1.8 and sell when residual > 1.8. Use 1.5x ATR stops and 2R targets. Require RSI(14) < 30 for longs and > 70 for shorts.

name: XAU Autocorrelation Momentum
concept: Uses lag-1 autocorrelation to identify momentum persistence and fade reversals.
instructions: Calculate lag-1 autocorrelation of returns over 40-bar window. If autocorr > 0.3, enter trend-following: buy on pullback to EMA10. If autocorr < -0.3, enter mean-reversion: buy when Z-score < -1.5. Use 1.8x ATR stops and 2.2R targets. Filter with RVOL > 1.2.

name: XAU Volatility of Volatility
concept: Measures volatility of volatility to identify extreme volatility compression before expansion.
instructions: Calculate 10-bar ATR, then calculate 20-bar standard deviation of ATR. When ATR_std < 0.3x its 100-bar average, mark as vol-of-vol squeeze. On expansion (ATR_std > 1.5x average), enter in direction of first 3-bar move. Use 2x ATR stops and 3R targets.

name: XAU Z-Score Acceleration
concept: Trades acceleration in Z-score to capture momentum shifts before price moves.
instructions: Calculate 20-bar Z-score of close. Calculate 5-bar change in Z-score. Buy when Z-score < -1.0 and Z-score_change > 0.3 (accelerating up). Sell when Z-score > 1.0 and Z-score_change < -0.3. Use 1.5x ATR stops and 2R targets. Gate to London/NY sessions.

name: XAU Hurst Exponent with Volatility Filter
concept: Combines Hurst exponent with volatility regime to optimize entry timing.
instructions: Calculate 50-bar Hurst exponent. If Hurst > 0.55 and ATR(14) > 1.5x ATR(50), enter trend: buy when price > EMA21. If Hurst < 0.45 and ATR(14) < 0.7x ATR(50), enter reversion: buy when Z-score < -1.5. Use 1.8x ATR stops and 2.5R targets.

name: XAU Regression Slope Flip
concept: Detects trend reversals by monitoring linear regression slope changes.
instructions: Calculate 20-bar linear regression slope of close. When slope flips from negative to positive and price > VWAP, buy. When slope flips from positive to negative and price < VWAP, sell. Use 2x ATR stops and 2.5R targets. Require ADX > 20 for confirmation.

name: XAU Standard Deviation Convergence
concept: Trades convergence of price to standard deviation bands for mean-reversion.
instructions: Calculate 20-bar mean and standard deviation of close. When price touches lower band (mean - 2*std) and RSI(14) < 35, buy. When price touches upper band (mean + 2*std) and RSI(14) > 65, sell. Use 1.5x ATR stops and 2R targets. Filter with efficiency_ratio < 0.25.

name: XAU Autocorrelation Volatility Ratio
concept: Uses autocorrelation and volatility ratio to identify high-probability setups.
instructions: Calculate lag-1 autocorrelation over 30-bar window. Calculate volatility ratio as ATR(10)/ATR(30). If autocorr > 0.25 and vol_ratio > 1.3, enter trend: buy on pullback to EMA15. If autocorr < -0.25 and vol_ratio < 0.7, enter reversion: buy when Z-score < -1.5. Use 1.8x ATR stops and 2.2R targets.

name: XAU Kalman Residual Trading
concept: Trades Kalman filter residuals to capture short-term mean-reversion.
instructions: Implement Kalman filter with process noise = 0.1, observation noise = 0.5. Calculate residual as (close - kalman_estimate) / kalman_std. Buy when residual < -1.8 and sell when residual > 1.8. Use 1.5x ATR stops and 2R targets. Require session_mask('london_ny') and RVOL > 1.1.

name: XAU Hurst Trend Strength
concept: Uses Hurst exponent to measure trend strength and optimize position sizing.
instructions: Calculate 40-bar Hurst exponent. If Hurst > 0.6, strong trend: enter on EMA20/EMA50 crossover. If Hurst < 0.4, weak trend: enter on Z-score extremes. Use 2x ATR stops and 3R targets for strong trends, 1.5x ATR and 2R for weak. Gate to high-liquidity sessions.

name: XAU Regression Curvature
concept: Detects price curvature using second derivative of linear regression to anticipate reversals.
instructions: Calculate 25-bar linear regression slope. Calculate 5-bar change in slope (curvature). Buy when slope < 0 and curvature > 0.2 (slope turning up). Sell when slope > 0 and curvature < -0.2. Use 1.8x ATR stops and 2.5R targets. Require price > VWAP for longs, < VWAP for shorts.
